headlines.title_en: US trade deficit narrows in June; imports fall for first time since start of year
headlines.summary_en: US trade deficit narrowed in June as imports fell for the first time since the start of the year, with declines spanning multiple categories. Data from the Commerce Department on Tuesday showed the goods and services trade deficit narrowed 5.6% month-over-month to $73.3 billion in June. Imports fell 1.8%, while exports declined 0.9%. The trade data indicated net exports continued to weigh on economic growth in the quarter. US trade figures have been volatile in recent months, affected by shifting tariff policies, supply-chain disruptions from the Middle East conflict, and heavy corporate investment in artificial intelligence. Although the Supreme Court struck down many import tariffs imposed by the Trump administration in the first quarter, the administration is still seeking other avenues to levy tariffs on imported goods. headlines.title_en: Guangdong places first local bank dual-variety financial bond with 'fixed-rate + floating-rate' structure
headlines.summary_en: On August 4, according to the Guangdong Branch of the People's Bank of China, on July 28, under the guidance of the Guangdong Branch of the PBOC, Shunde Rural Commercial Bank successfully issued Guangdong Province's first 'fixed-rate + floating-rate' dual-variety financial bonds by a local small and medium-sized bank in the interbank market, with a total issuance scale of 2.5 billion yuan and a 3-year tenor. This is also the first floating-rate financial bond issued by a local small and medium-sized bank in Guangdong Province. (Renmin Caixun)

headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.summary_zh: 最新报告显示，尽管政府持续借贷，但家庭和企业因房价下跌、收入增长乏力及利润空间收窄而减少借贷，中国第二季度债务与国内生产总值之比自2022年以来首次下降。该比率下降1.1个百分点，至308.2%。

headlines.title: 经济学家朱宁：鼓励大家投资股票等金融资产 而非房地产
headlines.summary: 据金融界，上海交通大学上海高级金融学院金融学教授朱宁近期再度阐释了自己的资产配置观点。他表示，自己仍然鼓励大家更多考虑股票等金融资产，而非房地产。朱宁指出，房地产是一个流动性很差的资产。最近特别是在低线级城市，房地产面临的最大问题并非价格下跌，而是有价无市——“卖不出去，没有人来买，这是一个资产最可怕的地方”。在他看来，股市虽有涨跌停板制度，但“你几乎可以想卖的时候把它卖出去，只是折价多少的问题”。他强调：“没有流动性的资产是不配谈价值的。” 朱宁进一步指出，房子一买就是上百万，是高度集中的资产；而股市则可以实现多元化分散灵活投资，投多少、投什么都可以动

headlines.title_en: Economist Zhu Ning: Encouraging investment in financial assets like stocks rather than real estate
headlines.summary_en: According to Financial Street, Zhu Ning, a finance professor at Shanghai Advanced Institute of Finance at Shanghai Jiao Tong University, recently reiterated his asset allocation views. He said he still encourages people to consider financial assets such as stocks more than real estate. Zhu noted that real estate is a highly illiquid asset. Recently, especially in lower-tier cities, the biggest problem facing real estate is not price declines but a market with no buyers—'you can't sell it, no one is buying, and that's the scariest thing for an asset.' In his view, although the stock market has price limit rules, 'you can almost always sell when you want to, it's just a question of the discount.' He stressed: 'An asset without liquidity is not worthy of discussing value.' Zhu further pointed out that buying a house costs millions and is a highly concentrated asset, while the stock market allows diversified and flexible investment, with flexibility in how much and what to invest in

headlines.title: 中国海外发展近84亿元竞得北京朝阳区广渠路宅地，楼面价8.14万元/平米
headlines.summary: 北京朝阳区南磨房乡广渠路宅地正式出让，该地块在经过现场185轮竞价后最终落槌。根据成交结果，中国海外发展有限公司（中国海外发展，00688.HK）旗下北京永鑫兴业房地产开发有限公司以83.99亿元收入囊中，成交楼面价81407元/平方米，溢价率19.13%。根据中指研究院监测，该地块成交楼面价也刷新了朝阳区涉宅用地TOP3位置。（澎湃）

headlines.title_en: China Overseas Land & Investment wins Beijing Chaoyang District Guangqu Road residential site for nearly 8.4 billion yuan, at 81,400 yuan per sqm floor price
headlines.summary_en: The residential plot on Guangqu Road in Nanmofang Township, Chaoyang District, Beijing, was officially transferred, concluding after 185 rounds of on-site bidding. According to the transaction results, Beijing Yongxin Xingye Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., a subsidiary of China Overseas Development Limited (China Overseas Development, 00688.HK), acquired it for 8.399 billion yuan, with a transaction floor price of 81,407 yuan per square meter and a premium rate of 19.13%. According to China Index Academy monitoring, the transaction floor price set a new top-3 record for residential land in Chaoyang District. (The Paper)

headlines.title_en: Xiaohongshu: In first half of year, assisted police in busting four black-market teams mass-faking registrations of professional accounts in cultural-tourism ticketing, real estate, and finance sectors, with 14 suspects total
headlines.summary_en: Xiaohongshu released a governance announcement on special actions for safe summer travel: As the summer travel peak hits nationwide, Xiaohongshu is intensifying governance of content and business ecosystems in the cultural tourism industry within its community, proactively submitting leads on black and gray industries to cooperate with police crackdowns. In April this year, the platform launched a special campaign against forced shopping, strictly addressing unlicensed travel solicitation and false advertising information. Since July, Xiaohongshu has strengthened special inspections of travel-related content and business environments, issuing risk alerts and search protections for popular outdoor spots such as 'Ferrata,' 'Shuangshimen,' 'Sayram Lake,' and 'Yingshan Douligou,' investigating leads on fraudulent traffic-generation and scam industry chains under guises like 'travel buddies' and 'carpool/group tours,' and strictly inspecting and removing unlicensed travel agencies, studios, and personal accounts. In the first half of the year, Xiaohongshu cooperated with police in multiple regions to crack down on batch-fraud registrations in cultural tourism ticketing, real estate, finance, and other industries

headlines.title_en: July housing market stays resilient: multiple cities see year-on-year sales growth; Shanghai luxury projects sell out on launch day
headlines.summary_en: In July, affected by high temperatures and the traditional off-season, property transactions in key cities weakened month-over-month, but remained resilient compared with the same period last year, with multiple cities seeing year-on-year growth in new and existing home transaction volumes. Shanghai's core high-end renovation projects performed strongly, with luxury homes again selling out on the day of launch.

headlines.title: Chinese families turn to cash and cautious stock bets as real estate avenues narrow
headlines.summary:
Chinese families are fast retreating from real estate, with many holding large cash reserves now cautiously weighing stock investments, marking a stark contrast with South Korea, where retail investors are aggressively using leverage to fuel equity bets at home and abroad.

headlines.summary_zh: 中国家庭正快速撤离房地产市场，许多家庭持有大量现金，如今谨慎考虑股票投资，这与韩国形成鲜明对比——韩国散户投资者正积极利用杠杆在国内和海外市场进行股票押注。第一季度，房地产占家庭资产的比例降至52%。

headlines.title_en: A-share new accounts hit 2.6554 million in July 2026, up 35.23% year on year
headlines.summary_en: Shanghai Stock Exchange data shows that new A-share accounts in July 2026 totaled 2.6554 million, down 7.30% month-over-month, but up 35.23% year-on-year from 1.9636 million in July 2025. Cumulative new accounts for 2026 reached 22.8168 million, up 56.69% year-on-year.

headlines.title: 显卡价格涨疯了，RTX50系列涨超1000元，华强北行情一日一变，厂商封仓，商户称写不了报价单
headlines.summary: 记者走访深圳华强北市场发现，消费级显卡价格出现明显上涨。以RTX 5060 Ti 8GB为例，目前市场售价已升至3400元，相比此前2350元的价格上涨逾千元，更高版本的RTX 5070 Ti 系列目前已经涨到8000元以上；高端产品涨幅更为明显，RTX 5090系列价格已从此前约2万元上涨至3.5万元左右。 “写不了报价单，一天一个价。”华强北多位商户告诉记者，硬件优先供应AI算力，推高了显卡成本，现在各大品牌工厂都在封仓，暂停对外批量出货，这样的突然涨价一时之间反应不过来。（21财经）

headlines.title_en: Graphics card prices soar: RTX 50 series up over 1,000 yuan, Huaqiangbei quotes change daily, manufacturers hoard stock, merchants say they can't issue price lists
headlines.summary_en: A reporter's visit to the Huaqiangbei market in Shenzhen found that consumer-grade graphics card prices have risen significantly. Taking the RTX 5060 Ti 8GB as an example, the current market price has risen to 3,400 yuan, an increase of over 1,000 yuan from the previous 2,350 yuan, while the higher-tier RTX 5070 Ti series has risen to over 8,000 yuan. High-end products saw even bigger gains, with the RTX 5090 series rising from around 20,000 yuan to about 35,000 yuan. 'We can't even write quotes—prices change every day,' multiple merchants in Huaqiangbei told reporters. Hardware is being prioritized for AI computing power, driving up graphics card costs, and major brand factories are now sealing warehouses and suspending bulk shipments, leaving the market struggling to react to such sudden price hikes. (21 Finance)

headlines.title_en: Tongyu Communication: Plans to spend 300 million yuan to acquire shares in Jiaxian Communication
headlines.summary_en: Tongyu Communication announced that it plans to use 300 million yuan of its own funds to purchase approximately 25.00% of Jiaxian Communication's equity (corresponding to 18.1527 million shares). The first phase involves acquiring 10.8916 million shares (about 15%) for 180 million yuan, and the second phase involves acquiring 7.2611 million shares (about 10%) for 120 million yuan, with the company having the right to decide whether to proceed within 3 months after the final payment date of the first phase. The transaction has been approved by the board of directors and does not constitute a related-party transaction or major asset restructuring.

headlines.title: 本源量子联合中国科大团队在“本源悟空”超导量子计算机上实现快速高保真度CZ门
headlines.summary: 本源量子宣布，其联合中国科学技术大学研究团队，在快速高保真两比特量子门控制方面取得新进展，相关工作以“Overcoming the Speed-Fidelity Trade-Off in Fast cz Gates via Cyclic Control”为题发表在国际物理顶级期刊Physical Review Letters。针对超导量子芯片中短时波形畸变引发的速度—保真度权衡，团队提出参数空间扩展受控相位门（PSE-CZ）方案，在不延长门时间的前提下显著抑制相干误差。该成果在“本源悟空”超导量子计算机上完成。（界面）

headlines.title_en: Origin Quantum, together with a USTC team, achieves fast high-fidelity CZ gates on the 'Origin Wukong' superconducting quantum computer
headlines.summary_en: Origin Quantum announced that, together with a research team from the University of Science and Technology of China, it has made new progress in fast, high-fidelity two-qubit quantum gate control. The work, titled 'Overcoming the Speed-Fidelity Trade-Off in Fast CZ Gates via Cyclic Control,' was published in the international top physics journal Physical Review Letters. Addressing the speed-fidelity trade-off caused by short-time waveform distortion in superconducting quantum chips, the team proposed a parameter-space-extended controlled-phase gate (PSE-CZ) scheme that significantly suppresses coherent errors without extending gate time. The results were completed on the 'Origin Wukong' superconducting quantum computer. (Interface)
